Key question: does the E9 exclusion (multimodal-only RAG) apply? MCBR-RAG handles multimodal cases, but it converts non-text components into text-based representations, so retrieval and generation operate on text. That puts it closer to text-only RAG than to multimodal RAG. It also runs experiments on Math-24 and Backgammon and compares against a baseline LLM, which meets the INCLUDE criterion. The "multimodal" label in the title makes E9 a possible reading, but the text conversion means E9 doesn't clearly apply. I'm choosing INCLUDE rather than MAYBE.

{"decision": "INCLUDE", "code": null, "reason": "Proposes RAG framework with experiments; non-text converted to text, so not multimodal-only RAG."}
